lines.t: Verse 1 —
The sky is fading into silver and gold,
Memories flicker like a story untold.
I’ve been walking highways carved in my soul,
Searching for a voice that calls me back home.
Pre-Chorus:
I feel the fire rising deep inside,
Pulling me toward the truth I used to fight.
Chorus:
You are the treasure I’ve been searching for,
The one thing that my soul’s been aching for.
When I’m falling, You pull me from the storm—
You are the treasure, You are the treasure.
Verse 2:
All the broken pieces I tried to erase,
You gather them and hold them in Your grace.
Every scar becomes a story of Your name,
I’m not lost—I’m finally unashamed.
Pre-Chorus:
I feel the fire rising deep inside,
Pulling me toward the truth I used to fight.
Chorus:
You are the treasure I’ve been searching for,
The one thing that my soul’s been aching for.
When I’m falling, You pull me from the storm—
You are the treasure, You are the treasure.
Even in the night, You’re lighting up my heart.
Even when I break, You never fall apart.
Hold me in the flame, refine me in the dark—
I’m Yours, I’m Yours.
Final Chorus (bigger, explosive):
You are the treasure I’ve been searching for,
The one thing that my soul’s been aching for.
When I’m falling, You pull me from the storm—
You are the treasure, You are the treasure.
